title: Cost Savings Operationalization: Sprint Cadence, Metrics Hub, and Phase Gates for Batching/Caching/Quantization
creator: Maya Patel
description: This initiative operationalizes cost-saving experiments across batching, prefix/KV caching, and quantization. Goal: deliver a repeatable sprint cadence, an interactive metrics hub for decisioning, and well-defined phase gates so engineering and product can safely roll cost optimizations to production without regressions in quality or latency. Deliverables: 1) Sprint template for econ experiments (hypothesis, guardrails, measurement), 2) Metrics Hub (Dashboards + experiment catalog + release status), 3) Phase gate checklist (canary thresholds, fallback policies, QA prompts), 4) Cross-functional playbook and handoff to GTM/solutions teams.
okrs: Objective: Reduce hosted per-token cost by 18% for standard text generation workloads by EOY
KR1: Achieve 10% median token-cost reduction across top-10 customer workloads through batching & KV cache by 2025-06-30
KR2: Validate 6% incremental savings from quantization profiles on 3 production models with <1% quality delta by 2025-05-31
KR3: Maintain 95th percentile latency regressions <= 10% during canaries
success_criteria: Experiment template used for >= 8 econ experiments in Q2
Metrics Hub shows experiment-level cost delta, latency delta, and quality regression flags for each run
Automated canary rollback triggers implemented in console for rollout >= 50% traffic
Cross-functional playbook published and acknowledged by SRE, Runtime, and DX teams
updates: 2025-02-12: Kickoff sync with ENG (Runtime), SRE, DX; agreed scope and owners. SRE to own canary rollback hooks; ENG to provide perf baselines by 2025-02-20.

2025-02-18: Decision: iterate quantization profiles as isolated experiments against the validation harness rather than broad model-level toggles to reduce blast radius. Trade-off: slightly slower rollout cadence for stronger safety.
2025-02-24: PM/Design review — DES- comments: request clearer visual for Metrics Hub experiment lineage. Action: Design to prototype experiment timeline by 2025-03-03.

2025-03-01: ENG update: batching engine POC (ENG-21034) shows 7% median token cost improvement in internal benchmark; integration with prefix cache under active dev. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/runtime/pull/8412
2025-03-03: Design prototype uploaded: https://drive.google.com/file/d/1X_example_prototype. Feedback loop scheduled 2025-03-06.

2025-03-04: Metrics Hub spec drafted in Confluence: https://confluence.redwood.com/display/ECON/Metrics+Hub+Spec. Includes dashboard mocks and experiment schema. Action: hook up Datadog dashboard with experiment tags (datadog link: https://app.datadoghq.com/dashboard/example-econ)
2025-03-05: Roadblock noted — dependency on runtime-1.22 kernel selection change (ENG-22190). Mitigation: schedule compatibility window and add a fallback quant profile for canaries.
risks_and_mitigation: Risk: Quality regressions from aggressive quantization. Mitigation: require quality A/B tests on held-out prompts and abort threshold at 1% delta in BLEU/ROUGE or model-specific evals.
Risk: Canary failure could impact SLAs. Mitigation: SRE to implement traffic steering + automatic rollback and maintain a 2% reserved capacity for rollback warmup.
Risk: Dashboards might not capture sample-level quality signals. Mitigation: instrument end-to-end eval hooks and store sampling snapshots for manual review.
